en.s: (For other uses, see Battle of Hastings (disambiguation).) The Battle of Hastings was fought on 14 October 1066 between the Norman-French army of William, the Duke of Normandy, and an English army under the Anglo-Saxon King Harold Godwinson, beginning the Norman conquest of England. It took place approximately 7 miles (11 kilometres) northwest of Hastings, close to the present-day town of Battle, East Sussex, and was a decisive Norman victory. The background to the battle was the death of the childless King Edward the Confessor in January 1066, which set up a succession struggle between several claimants to his throne.

zh.s: 黑斯廷斯战役于1066年10月14日爆发，交战双方是诺曼底公爵威廉率领的诺曼—法兰西军队，以及盎格鲁-撒克逊国王哈罗德·戈德温森率领的英格兰军队。这场战役开启了诺曼征服英格兰，最终以诺曼军队决定性获胜告终。战场位于黑斯廷斯西北约7英里（11公里），靠近现今东萨塞克斯郡巴特尔镇。1066年1月，忏悔者爱德华国王去世且没有子嗣，引发了多名王位继承人的争夺，这是战役的背景。

en.s: Battle on the Elster (German: Schlacht bei Hohenmölsen) was the third and last battle between the Salian king Henry IV of Germany and anti-king Rudolf of Rheinfelden, fought on October 14, 1080 near Hohenmölsen on the White Elster river. Rudolf's forces were victorious; however, he was mortally wounded and succumbed to his injuries the next day.

zh.s: 埃尔斯特河战役又称霍恩默尔森战役，是1080年10月14日在霍恩默尔森附近、白埃尔斯特河畔爆发的第三场、也是最后一场战役。交战双方是萨利安王朝的德国国王亨利四世和反国王莱茵费尔登的鲁道夫。鲁道夫的军队获胜，但他身受重伤，次日伤重不治。

en.s: The attack on Acre in 1179 was a naval raid launched by the Ayyubid fleet of Saladin against the Crusader fortress of Acre. The Ayyubids attacked the fort and inflicted heavy damage on the port before retreating.

en.s: The Battle of Ōshū (奥州合戦, Ōshū-kassen) was a major battle between the Kamakura government and the Northern Fujiwara that took place in the Tōhoku region of Japan from September 1 to October 14, 1189. It resulted in the downfall of the Northern Fujiwara and the completion of Minamoto no Yoritomo's nationwide domination through the annexation of Mutsu and Dewa Province by the Kamakura shogunate.

zh.s: 奥州战役（奥州合战）是镰仓幕府与奥州藤原氏之间的一场大战，于1189年9月1日至10月14日在日本东北地区爆发。战役导致奥州藤原氏灭亡，镰仓幕府吞并陆奥国和出羽国，源赖朝由此完成对日本全国的统治。

en.s: The Battle of Faughart (or Battle of Dundalk) was fought on 14 October 1318 between a Hiberno-Norman force led by John de Bermingham (later created 1st Earl of Louth) and Edmund Butler, Earl of Carrick, and a Scots-Irish army commanded by Prince Edward Bruce, Earl of Carrick, brother of King Robert I of Scots ('Robert the Bruce'). It was a battle of the First War of Scottish Independence and more precisely the Irish Bruce Wars. The defeat and death of Bruce at the battle ended the attempt to revive the High Kingship of Ireland.

zh.s: 法奥哈特战役又称邓多克战役，于1318年10月14日爆发。交战一方是约翰·德·伯明翰（后来受封为第一代劳斯伯爵）和卡里克伯爵埃德蒙·巴特勒率领的希伯诺—诺曼军队；另一方是苏格兰国王罗伯特一世（“罗伯特·布鲁斯”）之弟、卡里克伯爵爱德华·布鲁斯率领的苏格兰—爱尔兰军队。这场战役属于第一次苏格兰独立战争，更具体地说，是布鲁斯家族在爱尔兰发动的战争。布鲁斯战败并阵亡，这场战役也终结了复兴爱尔兰至高王权的尝试。

en.s: On October 14, 1322, Scottish forces defeated an English army at Old Byland in northern England. King Edward II narrowly escaped capture as he fled nearby Rievaulx Abbey.

zh.t: 苏格兰军在旧拜兰击败英军

en.s: The Battle of Nakhchivan (Persian: نبرد نخجوان) was fought between Kara Koyunlu under their Bey, Qara Yusuf and the Timurid Empire under the leadership of Timur's grandson Abu Bakr Mirza ibn Miran Shah, for control of Azerbaijan on October 14, 1406. Qara Yusuf decisively defeated the Timurids in this battle and took over Tabriz, the capital of the region.

zh.s: 1406年10月14日，黑羊王朝在贝伊卡拉·优素福率领下，与帖木儿帝国军队交战；后者由帖木儿之孙阿布·伯克尔·米尔扎·伊本·米兰沙赫率领。双方为争夺阿塞拜疆控制权而战。卡拉·优素福决定性地击败帖木儿军队，并占领该地区首府大不里士。

en.s: The Battle of Waidhofen took place on 14 October 1431 near the present town of Waidhofen an der Thaya in Austria. The Taborites led by Mikuláš Sokol from Lamberka were returning from a marauding ride when they were defeated by Imperial Austrian forces.

zh.s: 魏德霍芬战役于1431年10月14日在奥地利今魏德霍芬河畔塔亚附近爆发。米库拉什·索科尔·冯·兰贝卡率领的塔博尔派军队在劫掠后返程途中，遭奥地利帝国军队击败。

en.t: The General Court of the Massachusetts Bay Colony enacts the first punitive legislation against the Religious Society of Friends
en.s: The Massachusetts Bay Colony (1628–1691), more formally the Colony of Massachusetts Bay, was an English settlement on the east coast of North America around Massachusetts Bay, a territory inhabited by Algonquian Native American tribes. The colony was in a territory the colonists called New England, with initial settlements on two natural harbors and surrounding land about 15.4 miles (24.8 km) apart—the areas around Salem and Boston, north of the previously established Plymouth Colony.

en.s: Battle of Żurawno took place between 25 September and 14 October 1676, during the war Polish-Ottoman War (1672–1676). The battle ended in a draw; treaty of Żurawno was signed in its aftermath. In late August 1676, a large Ottoman-Tatar army of some 50,000 entered the southern Polish province of Pokucie. The invaders were faced by Jan III Sobieski, who had 20,000 soldiers. On 24 September 1676, Polish mounted units clashed with Tatars near Wojnilow and Dolha, and withdrew to the fortified camp in Zurawno. The Polish camp was protected from two sides by the Dniestr river, while in its front was the Krechowka river.

zh.s: 茹拉夫诺战役于1676年9月25日至10月14日波兰—奥斯曼战争（1672—1676）期间爆发，最终没有分出胜负，双方随后签订《茹拉夫诺条约》。1676年8月下旬，一支约5万人的奥斯曼—鞑靼联军进入波兰南部的波库采省，由扬三世·索别斯基率领的2万名士兵迎战。9月24日，波兰骑兵在沃伊尼乌夫和多尔哈附近与鞑靼人交战，随后退入茹拉夫诺的设防营地。波兰营地两侧有德涅斯特河保护，正面则有克雷霍夫卡河。

en.s: The Battle of Friedlingen took place on 14 October 1702, during the War of the Spanish Succession. Most of the fighting centred around Friedlingen, now a suburb of Weil am Rhein, on the current border between Baden-Württemberg in Germany, and Switzerland. A French force under Villars defeated an Imperial army commanded by Louis William, Margrave of Baden-Baden.

zh.s: 弗里德林根战役于1702年10月14日西班牙王位继承战争期间爆发。维拉尔率领的法军击败了巴登-巴登藩侯路德维希·威廉指挥的神圣罗马帝国军队。战斗主要发生在弗里德林根一带，该地如今是德国巴登-符腾堡州莱茵河畔魏尔市的一个城区，靠近巴登-符腾堡与瑞士边界。

en.s: The Spanish-Portuguese War between 1735 and 1737 was fought over the Banda Oriental, roughly present-day Uruguay. At the time, this part of South-America was sparsely populated and was on the border between Portuguese Brazil and the Spanish Governorate of the Río de la Plata. Spain claimed the area based on the Treaty of Tordesillas of 1494, but Portugal had founded the first city there, Sacramento Colony, in 1680.

zh.s: 1735年至1737年的西班牙—葡萄牙战争围绕东岸地区展开，该地大致相当于今乌拉圭。当时南美洲这一地区人口稀少，位于葡属巴西和西属拉普拉塔总督辖区的边界。西班牙依据1494年《托尔德西里亚斯条约》声称拥有该地区，但葡萄牙于1680年在当地建立了第一座城市——圣萨克拉门托殖民地。

en.s: The Siege of Pirna, sometimes referred to as the Investment of Pirna, took place from 10 September to 14 October 1756 as part of the Prussian invasion of Saxony during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). Following the occupation of Dresden by Frederick the Great on 9 September 1756, the Saxon army under Frederick von Rutowski had withdrawn southeast and taken up position at the fortified camp of Pirna.

en.s: The Battle of Hochkirch took place on 14 October 1758, during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). After several weeks of maneuvering for position, an Austrian army of 80,000 commanded by Lieutenant Field Marshal Leopold Josef Graf Daun surprised the Prussian army of 30,000–36,000 commanded by Frederick the Great. The Austrian army overwhelmed the Prussians and forced a general retreat.

zh.s: 霍赫基希战役于1758年10月14日第三次西里西亚战争（七年战争的一部分）期间爆发。奥地利军队先花数周调动阵地，随后由利奥波德·约瑟夫·道恩伯爵元帅率领8万人突袭腓特烈大帝指挥的3万至3.6万名普鲁士士兵。奥军压倒普军，迫使其全面撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Ölper was a battle at Ölper, now a district of Brunswick, on 13 October 1761. It occurred between a Franco-Saxon force and a Brunswick-Hanoverian force, lasted long into the night and ended in a Brunswickian victory. It was part of the Seven Years' War.

en.t: The first recorded ministry of education, the Commission of National Education, is formed in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth
en.s: The Commission of National Education (Polish: Komisja Edukacji Narodowej, KEN, Lithuanian: Edukacinė komisija) was the central educational authority in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, created by the Sejm and King Stanisław II August on October 14, 1773. Because of its vast authority and autonomy, it is considered the first education ministry in European history and an important achievement of the Polish Enlightenment.

zh.s: 国家教育委员会（波兰语：Komisja Edukacji Narodowej，简称KEN；立陶宛语：Edukacinė komisija）是波兰立陶宛联邦的中央教育主管机构，由议会和国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫二世·奥古斯特于1773年10月14日设立。由于该委员会拥有广泛的权力和自治权，它被视为欧洲历史上的第一个教育部，也是波兰启蒙运动的重要成就。

en.s: The Battle of Shallow Ford was an American Revolution skirmish that took place on October 14, 1780 in Huntsville, North Carolina. A company of 600 Loyalist militia, led by Colonel Gideon Wright and his brother Captain Hezikiah Wright, were attempting to cross the Yadkin River to join General Cornwallis in Charlotte. Colonel Joseph Williams gathered 300 Patriot militia and laid an ambush at the ford. A short battle followed, with the Patriot forces winning decisively. The Loyalist militia became scattered and fled. Fifteen casualties were reported, fourteen Loyalists and one Patriot, Henry Francis, a captain in the Virginia militia.

zh.s: 浅滩渡口战斗是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模战斗，于1780年10月14日在北卡罗来纳州亨茨维尔爆发。吉迪恩·赖特上校和弟弟希西家·赖特上尉率领600名效忠派民兵，试图渡过亚德金河，前往夏洛特与康沃利斯将军会合。约瑟夫·威廉姆斯上校召集300名爱国派民兵，在渡口设伏。随后双方短暂交战，爱国派取得决定性胜利。效忠派民兵溃散逃走。战斗共报告15人伤亡，其中效忠派14人，另有一名爱国派士兵亨利·弗朗西斯阵亡；他是弗吉尼亚民兵上尉。

en.s: The Battle of Elchingen, fought on 14 October 1805, saw French forces under Michel Ney rout an Austrian corps led by Johann Sigismund Riesch. This defeat led to a large part of the Austrian army being invested in the fortress of Ulm by the army of Emperor Napoleon I of France while other formations fled to the east. Soon afterward, the Austrians trapped in Ulm surrendered and the French mopped up most of the remaining Austrians forces, bringing the Ulm Campaign to a close. In late September and early October 1805, Napoleon carried out a gigantic envelopment of the Austrian army in Bavaria led by Karl Mack von Lieberich.

zh.s: 埃尔欣根战役于1805年10月14日爆发。米歇尔·内伊率领的法军击溃了约翰·西吉斯蒙德·里施指挥的奥军。这场败仗导致奥地利军队大部被法兰西皇帝拿破仑一世的部队围困在乌尔姆要塞，其他部队则向东逃走。不久后，被困乌尔姆的奥军投降，法军又击溃了大部分残余奥军，乌尔姆战役行动就此结束。1805年9月下旬至10月上旬，拿破仑曾在卡尔·马克·冯·莱贝里希率领的巴伐利亚奥军周围实施大规模包围。

en.s: The Battle of Memmingen was a battle at Memmingen during the 1805 German campaign of the Napoleonic Wars. It occurred on 14 October that year and culminated in the surrender of Karl Spangen to Jean-de-Dieu Soult's 4th Army Corps.

en.s: The twin battles of Jena and Auerstedt (older name: Auerstädt) were fought on 14 October 1806 on the plateau west of the river Saale in today's Germany, between the forces of Napoleon I of France and Frederick William III of Prussia. The decisive defeat suffered by the Prussian Army subjugated the Kingdom of Prussia to the French Empire until the Sixth Coalition was formed in 1812. Several figures integral to the reformation of the Prussian Army participated at Jena–Auerstedt, including Gebhard von Blücher, Carl von Clausewitz, August Neidhardt von Gneisenau, Gerhard von Scharnhorst, and Hermann von Boyen.

zh.s: 耶拿和奥尔施泰特两场战役于1806年10月14日在今德国萨勒河以西高原上爆发，交战双方是法国皇帝拿破仑一世的军队和普鲁士国王腓特烈·威廉三世的军队。普鲁士军队遭到决定性打击，普鲁士王国因此被法兰西帝国控制，直到1812年第六次反法同盟成立。参与战役的普鲁士军队改革重要人物包括格布哈德·冯·布吕歇尔、卡尔·冯·克劳塞维茨、奥古斯特·奈德哈特·冯·格奈森瑙、格哈德·冯·沙恩霍斯特和赫尔曼·冯·博因。

en.s: The Treaty of Schönbrunn (French: Traité de Schönbrunn), sometimes known as the Peace of Schönbrunn (German: Friede von Schönbrunn) or the Treaty of Vienna (German: Wiener Frieden), was signed between France and Austria at Schönbrunn Palace near Vienna on 14 October 1809. The treaty ended the Fifth Coalition during the Napoleonic Wars, after Austria had been defeated at the decisive Battle of Wagram on 5–6 July.

zh.s: 《美泉宫条约》又称《美泉宫和约》或《维也纳条约》，于1809年10月14日在维也纳附近的美泉宫由法国和奥地利签署。该条约结束了拿破仑战争期间的第五次反法同盟战争；此前，奥地利已在7月5日至6日的瓦格拉姆战役中遭受决定性败北。

en.s: The Battle of Sobral (13–14 October 1810) saw an Imperial French army led by Masséna probe the Lines of Torres Vedras, built and defended successfully by Wellington's Anglo-Portuguese Army. Masséna had to order a retreat at the beginning of March 1811 having lost 21,000 men from hunger and disease induced by the scorched earth policy of Wellington.

en.s: The Siege of Cattaro was fought between a British Royal Naval detachment and Montenegrin forces under Captain William Hoste, John Harper and Petar I Petrović-Njegoš respectively and the French garrison under command of Jean-Joseph Gauthier of the mountain fortress of Cattaro (now Kotor, Montenegro). The siege lasted from 14 October 1813 to 3 January 1814 during the Adriatic campaign of the Napoleonic Wars when the French surrendered. The engagement was fought in the Adriatic Sea for possession of the important fortress of Cattaro.

zh.s: 卡塔罗围城战于1813年10月14日至1814年1月3日进行，属于拿破仑战争亚得里亚海战役的一部分，最终法军投降。英皇家海军分遣队和黑山军队分别由威廉·霍斯特、约翰·哈珀和彼得一世·彼得罗维奇-涅戈什指挥；他们围攻了让-约瑟夫·戈捷指挥的法军守军。战斗围绕亚得里亚海沿岸的重要要塞卡塔罗（今黑山科托尔）的控制权展开。

en.s: The Battle of Liebertwolkwitz (German: Schlacht von Liebertwolkwitz, also the battle of Güldengossa or the cavalry-battle of Wachau) took place on 14 October 1813 between French forces commanded by field marshal Joachim Murat and the Sixth Coalition's Allied Army commanded by Russian field marshal Peter Wittgenstein. It occurred around Liebertwolkwitz, a Saxon town south of Leipzig, two days before the decisive battle of Leipzig.

en.s: The Christchurch Country by-election 1856 was a by-election held in the multi-member Christchurch Country electorate during the 2nd New Zealand Parliament, on 14 October 1856, and was, along with the Grey and Bell 1856 by-election, the second equal contested by-election in New Zealand political history. The by-election was caused by the resignation of incumbent MP Dingley Brittin and was won by John Ollivier. On nomination day (13 October) John Ollivier and Crosbie Ward were nominated, and after a show of hands in favour of Ollivier, Ward demanded a poll. John Ollivier was subsequently elected the following day.

en.s: The Second Battle of Auburn was fought on October 14, 1863, in Fauquier County, Virginia, between Union and Confederate forces in the American Civil War. Confederate forces led by Lt. Gen. Richard S. Ewell led a sortie to extricate Maj. Gen. J.E.B. Stuart's cavalry command, trapped between two Union columns and clashed with the rearguard of the Federal II Corps under Brig. Gen. Gouverneur K. Warren. Stuart was successfully extricated but the Federal wagon train avoided Confederate capture in the inconclusive fight.

en.s: The Battle of Guté Dili was fought on 14 October 1888 between an alliance of the Shewan forces of Ras Gobana Dacche and the Oromo ruler of Leqa Naqamte, Moroda Bekere, and Mahdist forces under governor Khalil al-Khuzani near Nejo in the modern Mirab Welega Zone of the Oromia Region of Ethiopia. en.s: Full general elections were held in Belgium on 14 October 1894, with run-off elections held on 21 October 1894. The elections followed several major reforms: they were the first held under universal male suffrage for those over the age of 25. This followed the abolition of tax qualifications, and increased the number of voters tenfold. Voting was also made compulsory. Provincial senators were introduced in addition to the existing directly elected ones. The electoral reforms were implemented in 1893 under the Catholic government led by Auguste Beernaert, who had been in power for nearly ten years, but who resigned because his proposal for proportional representation was rejected.

zh.s: 比利时于1894年10月14日举行全面大选，第二轮选举于10月21日举行。此次选举是在多项重大改革后举行的，首次实行25岁以上男性普选。此前，投票资格中的纳税要求被取消，选民人数因此增加到原来的十倍。投票也改为强制进行。除原有的直选参议员外，选举还增设省级参议员。奥古斯特·贝尔纳尔领导的天主教政府于1893年实施选举改革；他执政近十年后，因比例代表制提案遭否决而辞职。

en.s: A by-election for the seat of Rylstone in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly was held on 14 October 1895 because the Committee of Elections and Qualifications declared that the election of John Fitzpatrick at the election for Rylstone in July, with a margin of 6 votes, was void because of gross negligence by the returning officer by not initialing 266 ballot papers (19.6%).

zh.s: 新南威尔士州立法议会赖尔斯通选区于1895年10月14日举行补选。选举委员会认定，约翰·菲茨帕特里克在7月选举中虽以6票优势获胜，但由于选务官严重疏忽，没有在266张选票（占19.6%）上签名盖章，因此该选举无效。

en.s: The 1897 Victorian colonial election was held on 14 October 1897 to elect the 17th Parliament of Victoria. All 95 seats in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though 13 were uncontested. George Turner's Liberal government was returned with an increased majority.

zh.s: 维多利亚殖民地于1897年10月14日举行选举，选出第17届议会。立法议会95席全部改选，其中13席无人竞争。乔治·特纳领导的自由党政府连任，且多数席位增加。

en.s: The siege of Kimberley took place during the Second Boer War at Kimberley, Cape Colony (present-day South Africa), when Boer forces from the Orange Free State and the Transvaal besieged the diamond mining town. The Boers moved quickly to try to capture the area when war broke out between the British and the two Boer republics in October 1899.

zh.s: 第二次布尔战争期间，奥兰治自由邦和德兰士瓦的布尔军队围攻了开普殖民地金伯利镇，也就是今天南非的金伯利。1899年10月英国与两个布尔共和国开战后，布尔军队迅速行动，试图夺取这座钻石矿业城镇及周边地区。

en.s: The 1910 New South Wales state election was held on 14 October 1910 for all of the 90 seats in the 22nd New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in single-member constituencies with a second ballot if a majority was not achieved on the first. Both adult males and females were entitled to vote, but not Indigenous people.

zh.s: 新南威尔士州于1910年10月14日举行州选举，改选第22届立法议会全部90席。选区均为单议席；如果首轮无人获得多数票，则举行第二轮投票。成年男性和女性都有投票权，但原住民没有投票权。

en.t: Claude Grahame-White lands near the White House
en.s: On October 14, 1910, Claude Grahame-White flew a Farman biplane over Washington, D.C., and landed on Executive Avenue beside the White House.

zh.t: 格雷厄姆-怀特驾机在白宫旁降落
zh.s: 1910年10月14日，克劳德·格雷厄姆-怀特驾驶法尔芒双翼飞机飞越华盛顿，随后在白宫旁的行政大道降落。

en.t: Theodore Roosevelt is shot while campaigning in Milwaukee
en.s: On October 14, 1912, former U.S. president Theodore Roosevelt was shot by John Schrank while campaigning in Milwaukee. Despite being wounded, Roosevelt went on to deliver his scheduled speech.

zh.t: 西奥多·罗斯福在密尔沃基竞选时遇刺
zh.s: 1912年10月14日，美国前总统西奥多·罗斯福在密尔沃基竞选时遭约翰·施兰克枪击。虽然已经受伤，罗斯福仍按计划发表了演讲。

en.s: The Senghenydd colliery disaster, also known as the Senghenydd explosion (Welsh: Tanchwa Senghennydd), occurred at the Universal Colliery in Senghenydd, near Caerphilly, Glamorgan, Wales, on 14 October 1913. The explosion, which killed 439 miners and a rescuer, is still the worst mining accident in the United Kingdom. Universal Colliery, located on the South Wales Coalfield, produced steam coal which was much in demand. Some of the region's coal seams contained high quantities of firedamp, a highly explosive gas consisting of methane and hydrogen, and were prone to explosions. In an earlier disaster in May 1901, three underground explosions at the colliery killed 81 miners.

zh.s: 森赫尼德煤矿灾难又称森赫尼德爆炸，于1913年10月14日在威尔士格拉摩根郡卡菲利附近森赫尼德的环球煤矿发生。爆炸造成439名矿工和一名救援人员死亡，至今仍是英国最严重的矿难。环球煤矿位于南威尔士煤田，出产需求量很大的蒸汽煤。当地部分煤层含有大量瓦斯，这种由甲烷和氢气组成的气体极易爆炸，矿井因此容易发生爆炸。1901年5月，该煤矿曾发生三次井下爆炸，造成81名矿工死亡。

en.s: The Ovche Pole Offensive Operation (Bulgarian: Овчеполска настъпателна операция) (Serbian: Битка на Овчем Пољу) was an operation of the Bulgarian Army that occurred between 14 October 1915 and 15 November 1915 as part of the Serbian Campaign in World War I. Its aim was to seize the Vardar river valley, and to cut the vital railway linking Skopje with Thesaloniki to prevent the Serbian Army from being resupplied and reinforced by the Allied Expeditionary Force. The Bulgarian forces consisted of the Second Army (3rd Balkan Infantry Division, 7th Rila Division and the Cavalry Division with 182 guns) under the command of Lieutenant General Georgi Todorov.

zh.s: 奥夫切波列攻势（保加利亚语：Овчеполска настъпателна операция；塞尔维亚语：Битка на Овчем Пољу）是保加利亚军队在第一次世界大战塞尔维亚战役期间发动的一场行动，持续时间为1915年10月14日至11月15日。行动目标是夺取瓦尔达尔河谷，切断斯科普里至塞萨洛尼基的重要铁路，阻止协约国远征军向塞军补给和增援。保加利亚军队由格奥尔基·托多罗夫中将指挥，包括第二军（第3巴尔干步兵师、第7里拉师和骑兵师），配备182门火炮。

en.s: The Morava Offensive Operation in Serbian (Bulgarian: Моравска настъпателна операция), (Serbian: Битка на Морави) was undertaken by the Bulgarian First Army between 14 October 1915 and 9 November 1915 as part of the strategic offensive operation of Army Group Mackensen against Serbia in 1915. Under the command of Lieutenant General Kliment Boyadzhiev the Bulgarians seized the fortified areas of Pirot, Niš and the valley of the river Morava. As a result, the Serbian forces were compelled to retreat towards Kosovo and Metohija.

zh.s: 摩拉瓦攻势（保加利亚语：Моравска настъпателна операция；塞尔维亚语：Битка на Морави）由保加利亚第一军发动，持续时间为1915年10月14日至11月9日，是1915年麦肯森集团军群对塞尔维亚战略攻势的一部分。在克利门特·博亚吉耶夫中将指挥下，保加利亚军队夺取了皮罗特、尼什等设防地区以及摩拉瓦河谷。塞军因此被迫撤往科索沃和梅托希亚。

en.s: The Kingdom of Bulgaria participated in World War I on the side of the Central Powers from 14 October 1915, when the country declared war on Serbia, until 30 September 1918, when the Armistice of Salonica came into effect. After the Balkan Wars of 1912 and 1913, Bulgaria was diplomatically isolated, surrounded by hostile neighbors while lacking the support of any great power.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战期间的保加利亚
zh.s: 保加利亚王国于1915年10月14日对塞尔维亚宣战，从这天起站在同盟国一方参加第一次世界大战，直至1918年9月30日《萨洛尼卡停战协定》生效。此前，保加利亚在1912年和1913年巴尔干战争后陷入外交孤立，周边邻国多与其敌对，也没有大国支持。

en.s: The action of 14 October was a naval engagement of the First World War when the Imperial German Navy submarine SM U-139 attacked the Portuguese civilian steamer São Miguel and the Portuguese Navy naval trawler NRP Augusto de Castilho in the Atlantic Ocean on 14 October 1918.

zh.s: 1918年10月14日，第一次世界大战期间，德国帝国海军潜艇U-139号在大西洋袭击葡萄牙民用汽船“圣米格尔号”和葡萄牙海军拖网炮舰NRP“奥古斯托·德·卡斯蒂略号”。

en.s: The Treaty of Tartu (Russian: Тартуский мирный договор; Finnish: Tarton rauha; Swedish: Fredsfördraget i Dorpat) was signed on 14 October 1920 between Finland and Soviet Russia after negotiations that lasted nearly five months. The treaty confirmed the border between Finland and Soviet Russia after the Finnish Civil War and Finnish volunteer expeditions in Russian East Karelia that resulted in annexation of several Russian districts.

zh.s: 《塔尔图条约》（俄语：Тартуский мирный договор；芬兰语：Tarton rauha；瑞典语：Fredsfördraget i Dorpat）于1920年10月14日由芬兰和苏维埃俄罗斯签署，双方谈判近五个月。条约确认了芬兰内战以及芬兰志愿军远征俄罗斯东卡累利阿后，芬兰与苏维埃俄罗斯之间的边界；远征期间芬兰吞并了俄罗斯多个地区。

en.t: Winnie-the-Pooh is first published in Britain
en.s: On October 14, 1926, Methuen published A. A. Milne’s Winnie-the-Pooh in Britain, with illustrations by E. H. Shepard.

zh.s: 1926年10月14日，梅休因出版社在英国出版A. A. 米尔恩的《小熊维尼》，书中插图由E. H. 谢泼德绘制。
zh.n: 此日期指英国首版。

en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1935 was held on October 14, 1935 to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 18th Parliament of Canada. The Liberal Party of William Lyon Mackenzie King won a majority government, defeating Prime Minister R.B. Bennett's Conservative Party. The central issue was the economy, which was still in the depths of the Great Depression. Bennett, in office since the 1930 election, had done little to stimulate the economy during his first few years, believing that a policy of high tariffs and trade within the British Empire would correct the depression.

zh.s: 加拿大于1935年10月14日举行联邦大选，选出第18届加拿大议会众议院议员。威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金领导的自由党赢得多数席位，击败R·B·贝内特总理领导的保守党。竞选的核心议题是经济，当时加拿大仍处于大萧条低谷。自1930年大选起担任总理的贝内特在任初期几乎没有采取措施刺激经济，他认为提高关税、加强大英帝国内部贸易就能扭转萧条。

en.s: The 1940 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the ninth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1940 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The game opened cagily, both teams scoring just one point in the first 15 minutes. Cork then scored four goals (M. Fitzgerald (two), P. Hegarty, M. Buckley) in four minutes, essentially deciding the game before half-time.

zh.t: 1940年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1940年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛是第九届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该届锦标赛的决定性比赛。赛事是爱尔兰顶级球队之间的郡际卡莫吉比赛。开场较为谨慎，双方在前15分钟各得1分。随后科克队在4分钟内连进4球，进球者为M·菲茨杰拉德（2球）、P·赫加蒂和M·巴克利，基本在半场结束前就锁定胜局。

en.s: Operation Kopaonik was a large-scale Axis offensive launched against the Mihailović's Chetniks in Axis occupied Yugoslavia during World War II. The operation was inspired by Heinrich Himmler who believed that the annihilation of Draža Mihailović and his forces was a basis for a success in Serbia and South East Europe.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，轴心国在被占领的南斯拉夫发动科帕奥尼克行动，大规模进攻米哈伊洛维奇领导的切特尼克部队。行动受到海因里希·希姆莱的推动；他认为，消灭德拉查·米哈伊洛维奇及其部队是轴心国在塞尔维亚和东南欧取得成功的基础。

en.s: The Sobibor uprising (Polish: Powstanie w Sobiborze; German: Aufstand von Sobibór) was a revolt of about 600 prisoners that occurred on 14 October 1943, during World War II and the Holocaust at the Sobibor extermination camp in occupied Poland. It was the second uprising in an extermination camp, partly successful, by Jewish prisoners against the SS forces, following the revolt in Treblinka.

zh.s: 索比堡起义（波兰语：Powstanie w Sobiborze；德语：Aufstand von Sobibór）是第二次世界大战和大屠杀期间，约600名囚犯于1943年10月14日在德占波兰的索比堡灭绝营发动的起义。这是继特雷布林卡起义之后，犹太囚犯反抗党卫军、并取得部分成功的第二次灭绝营起义。

en.s: The second Schweinfurt raid, also called Black Thursday, was a World War II air battle that took place on 14 October 1943, over Nazi Germany between forces of the United States 8th Air Force and German Luftwaffe fighter arm (Jagdwaffe). The American bombers conducted a strategic bombing raid on ball bearing factories to reduce production of these vital parts used in all manner of war machines.

zh.t: 第二次施韦因富特空袭
zh.s: 第二次施韦因富特空袭又称“黑色星期四”，是第二次世界大战期间的一场空战，于1943年10月14日在纳粹德国上空爆发，交战双方是美国第八航空队和德国空军战斗机部队。美国轰炸机对滚珠轴承工厂发动战略空袭，试图削减这类关键零件的产量；滚珠轴承广泛用于各种战争机器。

en.t: World War II: The Second Philippine Republic, a puppet state of Japan, is inaugurated with José P. Laurel as its president
en.s: The Second Philippine Republic, officially the Republic of the Philippines and also known as the Japanese-sponsored Philippine Republic, was a pro-Axis government established on October 14, 1943, during the Japanese occupation of the islands until its dissolution on August 17, 1945.

zh.t: 第二菲律宾共和国成立
zh.s: 第二菲律宾共和国正式国名为菲律宾共和国，也称日本扶植的菲律宾共和国，是日本占领菲律宾期间建立的亲轴心国政府。该共和国于1943年10月14日成立，1945年8月17日解散。

en.t: Erwin Rommel dies after being forced to take poison
en.s: On October 14, 1944, German field marshal Erwin Rommel died after taking poison under pressure from Hitler’s regime.

zh.s: 1944年10月14日，德国陆军元帅埃尔温·隆美尔在希特勒政权的逼迫下服毒身亡。

en.t: Chuck Yeager makes the first crewed supersonic flight
en.s: On October 14, 1947, Chuck Yeager flew the Bell X-1 faster than the speed of sound over the Mojave Desert in California.

zh.t: 查克·耶格尔驾机突破音障
zh.s: 1947年10月14日，查克·耶格尔驾驶贝尔X-1飞机，在美国加利福尼亚州莫哈韦沙漠上空突破音速。

en.s: The Battle of Triangle Hill, also known as Operation Showdown or the Shangganling Campaign (Chinese: 上甘岭战役; pinyin: Shànggānlǐng Zhànyì), was a protracted military engagement during the Korean War. The main combatants were two United Nations (UN) infantry divisions, with additional support from the United States Air Force, against elements of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA) 15th and 12th Corps.
en.n: Korean War: The Battle of Triangle Hill is the biggest and bloodiest battle of 1952.

zh.s: 三角山之战又称“摊牌行动”或上甘岭战役，是朝鲜战争期间一场持续时间较长的军事交战。主要交战方是两支联合国军步兵师，并有美国空军支援；对手是中国人民志愿军第15军和第12军的部分部队。
zh.n: 朝鲜战争：上甘岭战役是1952年规模最大、伤亡最惨重的战斗。

en.s: The 1957 Valencia flood (Spanish: gran riada de Valencia) was a natural disaster that occurred on 13 and 14 October 1957 in Valencia, Spain. The flood resulted in significant damage to property and caused the deaths of at least 81 people. In response to the tragedy, the Spanish government devised and enacted the Plan Sur, which rerouted the city's main river, the Turia.

zh.s: 1957年瓦伦西亚洪灾（西班牙语：gran riada de Valencia）是1957年10月13日至14日在西班牙瓦伦西亚发生的自然灾害。洪灾造成重大财产损失，至少81人死亡。西班牙政府随后制定并实施南部改道计划，将图里亚河改道。

en.s: The 23rd Canadian Parliament was in session from October 14, 1957, until February 1, 1958. The membership was set by the 1957 federal election on June 10, 1957, and it changed only somewhat due to resignations and by-elections until it was dissolved prior to the 1958 election.

zh.s: 加拿大第23届议会于1957年10月14日至1958年2月1日召开。议会成员由1957年6月10日联邦大选选出。此后由于辞职和补选，议员组成只有少量变化，随后议会在1958年大选前解散。

en.s: The Aden Emergency, also known as the 14 October Revolution or the Aden Insurgency, was an armed rebellion led mainly by the National Liberation Front (NLF) and the Front for the Liberation of Occupied South Yemen (FLOSY) against the British Protectorate and Federation of South Arabia. It began on 14 October 1963 when tribes from Radfan attacked British troops and ended with the proclamation of independence of the People's Republic of Southern Yemen.

zh.s: 亚丁紧急状态又称“十月十四日革命”或“亚丁叛乱”，是民族解放阵线和被占领南也门解放阵线领导的武装起义，主要反抗英国保护国和南阿拉伯联邦。起义于1963年10月14日爆发，当天拉德凡部族袭击英军；最终以宣布成立南也门人民共和国、实现独立告终。

en.t: Khrushchev is removed as Soviet Communist Party leader
en.s: On October 14, 1964, the Soviet Communist Party removed Nikita Khrushchev from its leadership. Leonid Brezhnev was elected First Secretary.

zh.t: 赫鲁晓夫被解除苏共领导职务
zh.s: 1964年10月14日，苏共解除尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫的领导职务，列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫当选第一书记。

en.t: The Cals cabinet resigns in the Netherlands
en.s: On October 14, 1966, the Dutch cabinet led by Jo Cals resigned after the House of Representatives adopted a motion calling for better funding of national budget expenditure.

en.s: The Western Australian town of Meckering was struck by an earthquake on 14 October 1968. The earthquake occurred at 10:58:52 local time, with a moment magnitude of 6.5 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). Total damage amounted to $2.2 million with 20–28 injured. Monday, October 14, 1968, also happened to be a public holiday in Western Australia observing the Queen's Birthday.

zh.s: 1968年10月14日，西澳大利亚州梅克林镇发生地震。地震于当地时间10时58分52秒发生，矩震级为6.5级，最高麦加利震级为IX级（剧烈）。地震造成的损失总计220万美元，20至28人受伤。当天恰逢西澳大利亚州的公共假日，用于庆祝女王诞辰。

en.s: The popular uprising of 14 October 1973 (Thai: เหตุการณ์ 14 ตุลา, rtgs: Hetkan Sip-Si Tula, "October 14 Event"; or Thai: วันมหาวิปโยค, rtgs: Wan Maha Wippayok, "Day of Great Sorrow") was a watershed event in Thailand's history. The uprising resulted in the end of the ruling military dictatorship of anti-communist Thanom Kittikachorn and altered the Thai political system. Notably, it highlighted the growing influence of Thai university students in politics.

en.s: On October 14, 2004, Pinnacle Airlines Flight 3701, a Bombardier CRJ200 on a repositioning flight from Little Rock to Minneapolis, crashed while attempting an emergency approach to Jefferson City Memorial Airport in Missouri, United States. Both pilots, the only two people on board, were killed. en.s: The 2018 Bavarian state election took place on 14 October 2018 to elect the 180 members of the 18th Landtag of Bavaria. The outgoing government was a majority of the Christian Social Union in Bavaria (CSU), led by Minister President Markus Söder. The CSU recorded its worst result since 1950 with 37% of votes, a decline of over ten percentage points, although it remained by far the largest party in the Landtag.

zh.s: 2023年10月14日，澳大利亚就是否修改宪法、设立“原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民之声”机构举行公投，提案未获通过。
zh.n: 此日期指投票日，最终计票在之后完成。

en.s: The 2023 Louisiana Attorney General election was held on November 18, 2023, to elect the next attorney general of Louisiana, with the first round occurring on October 14. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Jeff Landry retired to successfully run for governor, leading to an open race. In the runoff, Louisiana Solicitor General Liz Murrill defeated attorney Lindsey Cheek by a margin of 33 percent.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2023年路易斯安那州总检察长选举
zh.s: 路易斯安那州于2023年11月18日举行总检察长选举，第一轮投票于10月14日进行。共和党籍现任总检察长杰夫·兰德里辞职竞选州长并成功当选，因此总检察长职位空缺。决选中，路易斯安那州副总检察长莉兹·默里尔以33个百分点的优势击败律师林赛·奇克。
zh.n: 本条记录的是资料框所列第一轮投票日期。

en.s: The 62nd New York Film Festival took place September 27 to October 14, 2024, presented by Film at Lincoln Center. RaMell Ross' historical drama film Nickel Boys was the opening film. Pedro Almodóvar's The Room Next Door was the festival's centerpiece. Steve McQueen's Blitz was the closing film.

zh.s: 第62届纽约电影节于2024年9月27日至10月14日举行，由林肯中心电影协会主办。拉梅尔·罗斯执导的历史剧情片《镍男孩》为开幕影片，佩德罗·阿莫多瓦执导的《隔壁房间》为中心影片，史蒂夫·麦奎因执导的《闪电战》为闭幕影片。

en.s: The 2025 Newfoundland and Labrador general election was held on October 14, 2025, to elect members to the 51st General Assembly of Newfoundland and Labrador. In a major upset, Tony Wakeham led the Progressive Conservatives to a majority government for the first time since 2011. With a popular vote share of 44.4%, the PCs won the smallest winning vote share of any majority government in Newfoundland and Labrador's electoral history.

zh.t: 2025年纽芬兰与拉布拉多省大选
zh.s: 纽芬兰与拉布拉多省于2025年10月14日举行大选，选出第51届省议会议员。托尼·韦克汉姆领导进步保守党意外赢得多数席位，这是该党自2011年以来首次赢得多数政府。该党获得44.4%的普选票，是纽芬兰与拉布拉多省历史上以最低得票率组成多数政府的政党。

en.t: Madagascar’s National Assembly votes to impeach Rajoelina
en.s: On October 14, 2025, Madagascar’s National Assembly voted to impeach President Andry Rajoelina after he issued a decree dissolving the assembly. The presidency disputed the legality of the vote.
en.n: This entry records the parliamentary vote, separately from the military takeover.

zh.t: 马达加斯加国民议会表决弹劾拉乔利纳
zh.s: 2025年10月14日，马达加斯加总统安德里·拉乔利纳颁令解散国民议会后，议会仍举行表决，通过对他的弹劾。总统府对表决的合法性提出异议。
zh.n: 此条记录议会表决，与军方接管权力分开描述。
